name: Again With the Zapped Giants
objectiveText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas . Miniaturization Residue  ( 10 )

comments.body:
This quest awards 25 reputation the first time, 5 each other times.

Interesting thing to note is this is one of the very few quests that doesn't hurt your Bloodsail reputation. Hence if you wanna have a friendly reputation with both the goblins and the pirates, this is one of the best quest to be done repeatedly.

1. It is repeatable, but, since both items needed are quest items, you need to accept the quest to do it. Kind of a classic repeatable quest.

2. For those getting attacked by guards in the Goblin cities, while neutral... it's simple... YOU STARTED THE NON-DUEL FIGHT! Whoever starts the fight, gets mobbed by the goblin bruisers.

3. This is the only way to increase your reputation with the goblins of the Steamwheeldle Cartel, as a whole. Otherwise, there is a repeatable for Gadgetzan alone. Only reason to gain reputation with them is to hit Honored, for the 10% discount in their cities.
But you get 21s! How can you beat that!
The mountain giants in the NW corner of the map can also be shrunk.  So, this quest can be completed at the same time as the Horde "mountain giant muisek" quest.
Question is what's the use in gaining rep with Steemwheedle Port?
it gives 500xp at 48 lvl:(
replies: The point of this repeatable quest is to get reputation with the Steamwheedle Cartel for whatever inane reason.

comments.body: Ok you guys this is a waste of time UNLESS your trying to get rep back from choosing bloodsail, im lvl 49 and im Honored with every goblin faction and all i did was do my normal thing QUEST to gain EXP just so happens i chose tanaris and STV to quest in because those were quest hotspots.

The 550xp is the standard xp you get for rep quests. One that comes to mind is the Argent Dawn Valor Token's one. So my guess is you gain a miniscule rep increase with the steamwheedle cartel for doing this over and over.
replies: For those who are insane and like to get up to Honored with those Goblins, this is what the quest is for.

comments.body: I did this quest again. The quest was written in red in my log so I thought I'd get lots of xp but only got 550, yes 550 xp. So although it was an easy quest, it wasn't worth 550, you might as well kill 11 giants and get the same xp.

This is an excellent repeatable reputation quest, especially for druids.  It awards 75 reputation for all the factions within the Steamwheedle cartel, and it's easy to do.  I can do it in less than ten minutes on my druid.  The giants are most plentiful underwater, have a fast respawn, and aquatic form gives you a major competitive edge.

This quest awards reputation for the Steamwheedle Cartel faction, about 0.01530 first time I turned in the repeating version. It's probably marked level 55 so it will keep paying off all the way up to 60.

Red quests never pay off more while they are red, they don't start dropping till they get yellow.

I'm not sure when it changed, but as of 1.13.4 you need to finish it within the 2 hour period, because if you need to abandon the quest to get the zapper again, it destroys all the miniaturization residue collected.

replies: I had the same thing happen to me.  You need to abandon the quest and then pick it up again from the goblin.  You will get another shrink machine and still have the residue from before your original abandonment.

I had the same problem. I used the shrinker for the quest in Camp M. and when I went back to get the rest of the residues my shrinker expired.  I abandoned the quest and lost the 7 residues I had and had to start over.  Some quests let you keep any quest items that are still in your Bank, but this quest will delete those too when you abandon it.

I had a hard time finding Zorbin Fandazzle.  I finally found him at the crossroad sign above Feathermoon Stronghold.  So Zorbin is not located within or around the buildings of Feathermoon Stronghold, but instead, if you take the road from Feathermoon Stronghold up the hill towards the Feralas interior, you will see him beside the direction sign once you reach the top of the hill.  He is selling trade supplies including a bronze tube, blasting powder and other stuff.  He did not offer me this repeatable quest - but maybe it is because I have reached honored for all four of the cartel members.  I was just trying to get to 20,999.  I wish we could get Revered with these 4 cartel members.
